 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width and full-height monochrome rules partition the image into cells.
    hlines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    vlines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_groups, col_groups = [], []
    start = 0
    for r in hlines + [h]:
        if start < r:
            row_groups.append(list(range(start, r)))
        start = r + 1
    start = 0
    for c in vlines + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_groups.append(list(range(start, c)))
        start = c + 1
    vals = [grid[r][c] for rs in row_groups for cs in col_groups for r in rs for c in cs]
    counts = Counter(vals)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next((v for v, n in counts.most_common() if v != background), background)
    out = []
    for rs in row_groups:
        row_out = []
        for cs in col_groups:
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in rs for c in cs)
            row_out.append(1 if n == 2 else background)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
"
